SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(c.issued) AS launch_dates
FROM card AS c
JOIN disp AS dp ON c.disp_id = dp.disp_id
JOIN client AS cl ON dp.client_id = cl.client_id
JOIN district AS d ON cl.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.type = 'gold'
GROUP BY d.A3;

    d.A3,
    c.issued
FROM card c
JOIN disp ON c.disp_id = disp.disp_id
JOIN account ON disp.account_id = account.account_id
JOIN district d ON account.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.type = 'gold'

questions.nlq: Could you identify the customers whose bank accounts have opening dates that align with either their loan approval timelines or their credit card issuance periods, and calculate the cumulative transaction values for each alignment scenario?

meanings.hidden_knowledge: When discussing alignment with loans, the relevant timing refers to the exact moment when a loan contract receives formal authorization and becomes financially active for the customer.
meanings.gt_sql:
WITH loan_alignments AS (
    SELECT 
        a.account_id,
        a.date AS alignment_date,
        'LOAN' AS alignment_type
    FROM account a
    INNER JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
    WHERE a.date = l.date
),
card_alignments AS (
    SELECT 
        a.account_id,
        a.date AS alignment_date,
        'CARD' AS alignment_type
    FROM account a
    INNER JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
    INNER JOIN card c ON d.disp_id = c.disp_id
    WHERE a.date = c.issued
)
SELECT 
    alignment_type,
    SUM(t.amount) AS cumulative_transaction_value
FROM (
    SELECT la.account_id, la.alignment_type
    FROM loan_alignments la
    UNION ALL
    SELECT ca.account_id, ca.alignment_type
    FROM card_alignments ca
) aligned_accounts
INNER JOIN trans t ON aligned_accounts.account_id = t.account_id
GROUP BY aligned_accounts.alignment_type

meanings.hidden_knowledge: When discussing alignment with credit cards, the relevant timing refers to when the plastic payment instrument was manufactured and officially registered to begin usage by the cardholder.
meanings.gt_sql:
WITH loan_aligned_accounts AS (
    SELECT 
        d.client_id,
        SUM(t.amount) AS loan_alignment_value
    FROM account a
    JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
    JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
    JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id AND a.date = l.date
    GROUP BY d.client_id
),
card_aligned_accounts AS (
    SELECT 
        d.client_id,
        SUM(t.amount) AS card_alignment_value
    FROM account a
    JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
    JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
    JOIN card c ON d.disp_id = c.disp_id AND a.date = c.issued
    GROUP BY d.client_id
)
SELECT 
    COALESCE(la.client_id, ca.client_id) AS client_id,
    COALESCE(la.loan_alignment_value, 0) AS loan_alignment_value,
    COALESCE(ca.card_alignment_value, 0) AS card_alignment_value
FROM loan_aligned_accounts la
FULL OUTER JOIN card_aligned_accounts ca ON la.client_id = ca.client_id;
